race.comment: TANNIN (7) looked good winning on debut here when heavily backed, which saw him sent out favourite in a Listed race at Eagle Farm when last seen two months ago. Has since been given a short break and comes way back in class now with Berry on from gate one. REMEMBER JACK (2) was good fresh at Wyong and should be right there again from FLORINO (1) who is off a decent spell but can figure. EXPIDO (5) was slow into stride but still managed to place when a 5 length second over 1100m at Wyong. Fitter and a threat. ELLOFADUDE (8) comes into this after winning over 1250m at Gunnedah in the latest appearance three-and-a-half months ago. The most recent effort was a handy performance but will find this tougher.
